relationships.rationale: Two Survey passages both estimate FY25 real GDP growth at 6.4 percent.
RBI assessment and economic-review text both report 6.5 percent growth for 2024-25.
RBI 6.5 percent for 2024-25 matches IMF 2024/25 real GDP estimate of 6.5.
RBI narrative 4.6 percent headline inflation matches appendix CPI 4.6 for 2024-25.
Survey 6.4 percent (first-advance style) versus RBI 6.5 percent (SAE) are different estimate vintages for the same fiscal year.
6.5 percent in 2024-25 versus 9.2 percent a year earlier are different periods.
Survey and RBI both cite 5.4 percent inflation for FY24 / previous year.
IMF 2024/25 CPI 4.6 aligns with RBI average headline inflation 4.6 for 2024-25.
